meta.source: U.S. Preventive Services Task Force — A & B Recommendations
meta.notes: Age and sex eligibility encoded manually from USPSTF recommendation descriptions. Conditional recommendations flagged where universal eligibility cannot be determined by age/sex alone.

recommendations.name: Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm Screening
recommendations.condition_note: Applies to men who have ever smoked (at least 100 cigarettes in their lifetime).
recommendations.doctor_prompt: Ask your doctor: 'I've smoked in the past — am I due for a one-time ultrasound to check for an abdominal aortic aneurysm?'
recommendations.description: A one-time ultrasound to check for a dangerous bulge in the main artery in your abdomen. Recommended for men 65–75 who have ever smoked.

recommendations.name: Anxiety Disorders Screening — Adults
recommendations.description: Screening for anxiety disorders, including during pregnancy and postpartum. Recommended for all adults 18–64.

recommendations.name: Aspirin to Prevent Preeclampsia
recommendations.condition_note: Applies to pregnant people at high risk for preeclampsia.
recommendations.doctor_prompt: Ask your doctor: 'Am I at high risk for preeclampsia, and should I be taking low-dose aspirin during my pregnancy?'
recommendations.description: Low-dose aspirin (81mg/day) after 12 weeks of pregnancy to reduce the risk of preeclampsia in high-risk pregnancies.

recommendations.name: Asymptomatic Bacteriuria Screening — Pregnant
recommendations.plain_name: Urinary tract infection screening during pregnancy
recommendations.condition_note: Applies to pregnant people only.
recommendations.doctor_prompt: Ask your doctor: 'Should I be screened for a urinary tract infection as part of my prenatal care?'
recommendations.description: A urine culture to check for bacteria in the urine during pregnancy, even if there are no symptoms.

recommendations.name: BRCA-Related Cancer Risk Assessment
recommendations.plain_name: Genetic counseling for BRCA gene mutations
recommendations.condition_note: Applies to women with a personal or family history of breast, ovarian, tubal, or peritoneal cancer, or ancestry associated with BRCA1/2 mutations.
recommendations.doctor_prompt: Ask your doctor: 'Given my family history, should I be assessed for BRCA gene mutations?'
recommendations.description: A risk assessment and, if indicated, genetic counseling and testing for gene mutations that significantly raise the risk of breast and ovarian cancer.

recommendations.name: Breast Cancer Risk-Reducing Medications
recommendations.plain_name: Medications to reduce breast cancer risk
recommendations.condition_note: Applies to women at increased risk for breast cancer and low risk for adverse medication effects.
recommendations.doctor_prompt: Ask your doctor: 'Am I at increased risk for breast cancer, and would risk-reducing medication be appropriate for me?'
recommendations.description: Medications like tamoxifen or raloxifene that can reduce the risk of breast cancer in women who are at increased risk.

recommendations.name: Breast Cancer Screening
recommendations.description: Mammography screening for breast cancer every other year. Recommended for all women 40–74.

recommendations.name: Cervical Cancer Screening
recommendations.plain_name: Cervical cancer screening (Pap smear / HPV test)
recommendations.description: A Pap smear every 3 years, or an HPV test every 5 years (or both together) for women 30–65. Recommended for all women 21–65.

recommendations.name: Chlamydia and Gonorrhea Screening
recommendations.condition_note: Recommended for all sexually active women 24 and younger. Also recommended for older women at increased risk.
recommendations.doctor_prompt: Ask your doctor: 'Should I be screened for chlamydia and gonorrhea based on my age and sexual history?'
recommendations.description: STI screening for chlamydia and gonorrhea. Recommended for sexually active women 24 and younger, and older women at increased risk.

recommendations.name: Colorectal Cancer Screening
recommendations.description: Screening for colorectal cancer using one of several methods (colonoscopy, stool tests, etc.). Recommended for all adults 45–75.

recommendations.name: Depression Screening — Adults
recommendations.description: Screening for depression, including during and after pregnancy. Recommended for all adults.

recommendations.name: Prediabetes and Type 2 Diabetes Screening
recommendations.condition_note: Applies to adults who are overweight or obese.
recommendations.doctor_prompt: Ask your doctor: 'Given my weight, should I be screened for prediabetes or type 2 diabetes?'
recommendations.description: Blood sugar testing to check for prediabetes and type 2 diabetes. Recommended for adults 35–70 who are overweight or obese.

recommendations.name: Falls Prevention — Exercise Interventions
recommendations.condition_note: Applies to community-dwelling adults 65+ at increased risk for falls.
recommendations.doctor_prompt: Ask your doctor: 'Am I at increased risk for falls, and should I be referred to a fall prevention exercise program?'
recommendations.description: Referral to exercise programs to prevent falls and fall-related injuries in older adults at increased risk.

recommendations.name: Folic Acid Supplementation
recommendations.plain_name: Folic acid supplement (pregnancy prevention of birth defects)
recommendations.condition_note: Applies to people who are pregnant or planning to become pregnant.
recommendations.doctor_prompt: Ask your doctor: 'Should I be taking a folic acid supplement, and what dose is right for me?'
recommendations.description: A daily folic acid supplement (0.4–0.8mg) to reduce the risk of neural tube defects in pregnancy. Recommended for people planning or capable of pregnancy.

recommendations.name: Gestational Diabetes Screening
recommendations.condition_note: Applies to pregnant people after 24 weeks of gestation.
recommendations.doctor_prompt: Ask your doctor: 'When should I be screened for gestational diabetes during my pregnancy?'
recommendations.description: Blood sugar screening to check for diabetes that develops during pregnancy, typically after 24 weeks.

recommendations.name: Healthy Diet and Physical Activity Counseling
recommendations.condition_note: Applies to adults with cardiovascular risk factors such as high blood pressure, high cholesterol, or mixed dyslipidemia.
recommendations.doctor_prompt: Ask your doctor: 'Do I have cardiovascular risk factors that qualify me for free diet and physical activity counseling?'
recommendations.description: Behavioral counseling to encourage a healthy diet and regular physical activity in adults with cardiovascular risk factors.

recommendations.name: Hepatitis B Screening — Adults
recommendations.condition_note: Applies to adults at increased risk for hepatitis B infection (e.g., born in countries with HBV prevalence ≥2%, U.S.-born people not vaccinated as infants whose parents were born in high-prevalence regions, or HIV-positive individuals).
recommendations.doctor_prompt: Ask your doctor: 'Based on my background or risk factors, should I be screened for hepatitis B?'
recommendations.description: Blood test to screen for hepatitis B virus infection in adults at increased risk.

recommendations.name: Hepatitis C Screening
recommendations.description: A one-time blood test to check for hepatitis C infection. Most people who have it don't know. Recommended for all adults 18–79.

recommendations.name: Hypertension Screening
recommendations.description: Blood pressure measurement to screen for high blood pressure. Recommended for all adults 18 and older.

recommendations.name: HIV Screening
recommendations.description: Blood test to screen for HIV. Recommended for all adults and adolescents 15–65. Older adults at increased risk should also be screened.

recommendations.name: Intimate Partner Violence Screening — Women
recommendations.description: Screening for intimate partner violence (domestic violence) and referral to support services when needed. Recommended for all women of reproductive age.

recommendations.name: Lung Cancer Screening
recommendations.condition_note: Applies to adults with a 20 pack-year smoking history who currently smoke or quit within the past 15 years.
recommendations.doctor_prompt: Ask your doctor: 'Based on my smoking history, do I qualify for a yearly low-dose CT scan to screen for lung cancer?'
recommendations.description: A yearly low-dose CT scan to screen for lung cancer in adults 50–80 with a significant smoking history.

recommendations.name: Weight Loss to Prevent Obesity-Related Morbidity — Adults
recommendations.condition_note: Applies to adults with a BMI of 30 or higher.
recommendations.doctor_prompt: Ask your doctor: 'My BMI is over 30 — am I eligible for free weight loss counseling or a structured program?'
recommendations.description: Referral to intensive behavioral counseling programs to support weight loss in adults with obesity.

recommendations.name: Osteoporosis Screening — Women
recommendations.description: A bone density scan to screen for osteoporosis and fracture risk. Recommended for all women 65 and older, and for younger postmenopausal women at increased risk.

recommendations.name: Perinatal Depression Prevention
recommendations.condition_note: Applies to pregnant and postpartum people at increased risk for perinatal depression.
recommendations.doctor_prompt: Ask your doctor: 'Am I at risk for perinatal depression, and should I be referred to counseling during or after my pregnancy?'
recommendations.description: Counseling interventions to prevent depression during and after pregnancy for people at increased risk.

recommendations.name: Pre-Exposure Prophylaxis (PrEP) for HIV Prevention
recommendations.condition_note: Applies to adults at increased risk for HIV acquisition.
recommendations.doctor_prompt: Ask your doctor: 'Based on my risk factors, should I be taking PrEP to prevent HIV?'
recommendations.description: A daily medication (PrEP) that significantly reduces the risk of getting HIV. Recommended for adults at increased risk.

recommendations.name: Skin Cancer Prevention Counseling
recommendations.condition_note: Applies to fair-skinned people aged 6 months to 24 years.
recommendations.doctor_prompt: Ask your doctor: 'Should I receive counseling about reducing my UV exposure and skin cancer risk?'
recommendations.description: Counseling about minimizing UV exposure to reduce the risk of skin cancer. Recommended for fair-skinned people up to age 24.

recommendations.name: Statin Use for Cardiovascular Disease Prevention
recommendations.condition_note: Applies to adults with one or more cardiovascular risk factors (dyslipidemia, diabetes, hypertension, or smoking) and an estimated 10-year CVD risk of 10% or greater.
recommendations.doctor_prompt: Ask your doctor: 'Do I have enough cardiovascular risk factors to qualify for a free statin prescription under preventive care?'
recommendations.description: A statin medication to prevent a first heart attack or stroke in adults 40–75 with cardiovascular risk factors.

recommendations.name: Syphilis Screening
recommendations.condition_note: Applies to adults at increased risk for syphilis infection.
recommendations.doctor_prompt: Ask your doctor: 'Based on my sexual history, should I be screened for syphilis?'
recommendations.description: Blood test to screen for syphilis. Recommended for adults at increased risk.

recommendations.name: Tobacco Cessation Interventions — Adults
recommendations.condition_note: Applies to adults who currently use tobacco.
recommendations.doctor_prompt: Ask your doctor: 'I currently smoke — what free cessation counseling or medications am I entitled to?'
recommendations.description: Counseling and medications to help quit smoking and other tobacco use. Recommended for all adults who currently use tobacco.

recommendations.name: Unhealthy Alcohol Use Screening — Adults
recommendations.description: Screening for unhealthy alcohol use and brief counseling to reduce it. Recommended for all adults 18 and older.

recommendations.name: Impaired Visual Acuity in Older Adults — Screening
recommendations.description: Screening for vision problems in older adults. Recommended for adults 65 and older.
